benefits_summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60 for unorganized sector workers, based on monthly contribution amount.
documents_required: Active Savings Bank or Post Office Account
application_steps: Approach the bank branch or post office where your savings account is held.
Fill the APY registration form and select your pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
Maintain monthly balance for auto-debit contribution.
